# Footer

`email/footer` &middot; section-level &middot; category: email

## Purpose

Compliance footer: brand name, postal address, unsubscribe and manage-preferences links, plus optional logo, description, social links, navigation, legal links, copyright and disclaimer.

## Required fields

None.

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | text |  |
| `social` | socialLinks |  |
| `nav` | links |  |
| `legal` | links |  |
| `copyright` | text |  |
| `disclaimer` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Brand name, address, unsubscribe and manage-preferences links.
- **rich**: Adds the logo above the content. Pass description, social, nav, legal and copyright for the full footer. Sets `showLogo: true`.
- **minimal**: Smaller footer with tighter spacing. Sets `gap: @spacing.sm`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.md @theme.section.paddingX @spacing.xl @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.md"` |
| `showLogo` | boolean | `false` |
| `logoWidth` | length | `"120px"` |
| `socialVariant` | one of `default`, `round`, `text` | `"default"` |
| `linkColor` | color | `"@colors.mutedText"` |
| `unsubscribeLabel` | text | `"Unsubscribe"` |
| `preferencesLabel` | text | `"Manage preferences"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fine. Keep footer text at 12px or above. | Fine. Gmail may add its own unsubscribe control separately. | Text and link colors swap via dm-* classes where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('email/footer', {
  "description": "Sustainable everyday clothing, made to last. Designed in Portland, made in Portugal.",
  "social": [
    {
      "network": "instagram",
      "href": "https://instagram.com/example",
      "label": "Instagram"
    },
    {
      "network": "facebook",
      "href": "https://facebook.com/example",
      "label": "Facebook"
    },
    {
      "network": "pinterest",
      "href": "https://pinterest.com/example",
      "label": "Pinterest"
    }
  ],
  "nav": [
    {
      "label": "Shop",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/all"
    },
    {
      "label": "Our story",
      "href": "https://example.com/pages/about"
    },
    {
      "label": "Help",
      "href": "https://example.com/pages/help"
    }
  ],
  "legal": [
    {
      "label": "Privacy policy",
      "href": "https://example.com/policies/privacy"
    },
    {
      "label": "Terms of service",
      "href": "https://example.com/policies/terms"
    }
  ],
  "copyright": "© Placeholder Brand. All rights reserved.",
  "disclaimer": "You are receiving this email because you signed up at example.com."
}) ]]
```
